title: Visual Style Shift & New Tool Onboarding
text: Visualize only what warrants it, and it is the harder call because cutting eight planned deliverables looks like less work while being the correct one. The narration credential is worth restating plainly because it spans two months. It was diagnosed as an inactive key, reported to the people who administer the account, and never silently absorbed into the schedule. Work continued around it. The dependency itself simply was not mine to close. Then the direction changed again. Prof Nick introduced a new production tool and a distinct visual style, a creative call, not a correction. I onboarded onto the tool, sculpted what the style shift meant technically, and delivered three sample videos in the new style to Prof Sridhar for review. Three weeks, 20 hours documented in each, 60 hours for the month. Status: In compliance. Month three then. An upstream dependency handled without stalling. Production batched and chained so rebuild stayed cheap. 12 planned topics cut to the four that warrant animation. A new tool and a new visual language absorbed inside a fortnight. And three samples delivered for review. Sculpt then rebuilt. Med heavy month three.
